name: CRT Tube — effect fixture
description: Proving fixture for the crt-tube Effect and the full two-stage TV chain: ntsc-signal (the cable/decoder — bandwidth limits, imperfect separation, hue jitter, ghost, snow) feeds crt-tube (the display — gaussian-beam scanlines that swell on bright lines, slot-mask phosphor structure, barrel curvature, rounded-glass bezel with inner shadow, content-tinted halation). Dialed to the blurry '80s consumer slot-mask register; the sharp late-era register is the same param surface (grille mask, tight focus, near-flat curvature, high luma bandwidth). Big display type on dark makes the mask, beam profile, and halation read at a glance. Field parity and signal temporal terms ride a deterministic ~30 Hz frame clock (ADR-0012) — scrub and export agree. Full-frame piece; the near-black backgroundFill backstops the carved bezel surround. Fixture — exercises the pipeline, not held to the deliverable floors.
